manga.description: Fixture series for suwayomi-nx tests: 3 chapters of 10 JPEG pages, 1000x1500. Every page shows its series, chapter and page number in big letters, and a colour code in its top-right corner that the tests read back from screenshots. This description is long on purpose: the details screen shows its first five lines and opens the rest with a tap, so the tests can check both. It ends here.
